alert_summary: A high-severity phishing attempt with impersonation was detected, targeting Jane Tan (CFO) at victimcorp.com from an unknown sender domain and IP. The urgent subject line and lack of known threat context warrant immediate investigation.

risk_assessment.rationale: The alert indicates a potential phishing attack impersonating the CFO's support email, which is highly suspicious given the unknown status of the sender's domain (cfo.support) and IP (185.220.101.47). The subject line 'Urgent: Invoice Payment Confirmation Required' suggests social engineering tactics to prompt immediate action. While the risk is high due to the target being a high-value individual, confidence remains medium because there is no additional context on recent similar incidents or known threats against victimcorp.com.

recommended_actions: Escalate to the incident response / Tier 2 team
Verify whether the source IP/user is a known, expected service account or automation
Preserve logs and evidence for the affected host pending further investigation
recommended_actions_freeform_experimenta: Conduct a thorough review of the email's headers and body content to identify any additional indicators of compromise (IOCs) or suspicious patterns.
Check if there have been recent reports of similar phishing campaigns targeting financial departments or high-value individuals within victimcorp.com.
Verify whether jane.tan@victimcorp.com has previously received emails from cfo.support@secure-invoice-updates.com or related domains to assess legitimacy.
Analyze the IP address 185.220.101.47 for any historical malicious activity or association with known threat actors.
Consider reaching out to jane.tan@victimcorp.com to confirm if she was expecting this email and whether she took any action on it.
Review internal logs to determine if there have been any unusual login attempts or access patterns from the recipient's account following the receipt of this email.
triage_rationale_experimental: While the alert presents several red flags indicative of a phishing attempt, the lack of additional context or historical data on similar incidents makes it difficult to confidently classify as either true or false positive.
